title: feat(spec): declare the whole-deployment export, every installed package as installable packages in one read (`PackageExportBundleSchema`)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9MxfAf9Gx3CPUtLb43fGSBY)_
Part of #28914

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (an `os package export` row and section) and `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` (its export paragraph, which names only the per-package `GET /packages/:id/export`). Both belong with the server slice that mounts the read and adds the command: taught today, they would send a reader to a route no runtime serves. No `skills/**` file teaches package export.
Ruling-ref: 6568804196

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在 `@objectstack/spec/api` 声明「整租户本体导出」这个读的回答形状 `PackageExportBundleSchema`:`{ packages }`,一次给出部署里除平台自带包以外的全部已安装包，每一项就是现有单包导出 `GET /packages/:id/export` 的回答，按依赖顺序排好(基础包在前，它的 `.custom` 配对包在后)。路由 `GET /packages/export` 和 `os package export` 命令是下一张服务端卡的事，本 PR 不碰运行时。
- 为什么改:官网承诺「本体是你的，可以导出到开源运行时跑」,今天只能一个包一个包导；您在 docs.objectos.ai #334 裁定「同意，同时立开发卡」,按车道规矩先定 spec 形状，服务端卡 `Blocked-by` 本 PR。
- 风险与回滚:纯新增，没有任何现有形状或接受集变化；还没有运行时提供这个路由，所以对线上零影响。回滚即撤掉本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` 新增的 `PackageExportBundleSchema` 及其上方说明(选哪些包、什么顺序、凭据不出门、门禁和查询参数);`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts` 新增的 5 条测试;`.changeset/28914-package-export-bundle.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`,应看到 30 条全过(其中 5 条是本次新增)。
- 需要你做的:批准新公开名(路由路径 `GET /api/v1/packages/export`、schema 名 `PackageExportBundleSchema`、键 `packages`)和「平台自带包(manifest `scope: 'system'`)不进导出」这条选择规则；批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **`PackageExportBundleSchema`** (with `PackageExportBundle` and `PackageExportBundleParsed`) in `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/spec/api`. It declares the `data` of `GET /api/v1/packages/export`, dispatcher-served and enveloped like its lifecycle siblings: `{ packages: PackageExportManifest[] }`, strict at the top level.
  - **One producer.** `packages` is `z.array(PackageExportManifestSchema)`: each entry is exactly what `GET /packages/:id/export` answers, and a test pins that the element IS that schema (identity, not a copy). A `.custom` pair is its own entry with its override declarations (ADR-0146 D8 item 3); environment customizations stay where the per-package export places them, under the package that owns them.
  - **Which packages.** Every package the deployment holds, enabled or not, each once, except the platform's own (manifest `scope: 'system'`, which every runtime ships for itself). A pair of a platform base is still exported. A metadata item bound to no package is in no entry; ADR-0146 D11's migration binds it first.
  - **Order.** ADR-0141 D5's, the order a boot hydrates installed packages in: an entry comes after every entry its package's `manifest.dependencies` names, so a pair comes after its base. The consumer installs in the order listed and never re-sorts.
  - **No credential value.** The per-package export already withholds credential positions (it reads the `served` audience, which `decorateMetadataItems` redacts); the bundle adds no second rule, and a `credentialRef` stays a reference.
  - **The door, as declared for the server slice.** The per-package export's read gate (`studio.access` or `setup.access`, or a system context). A closed, empty query set: a parameter is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming it. Whole or absent: a package whose export cannot be assembled fails the read, naming it.
- **Generated:** `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx` and `content/docs/references/index.mdx` (1594 → 1595 schemas), `packages/spec/api-surface/api.json` (+3 names), `packages/spec/export-origins/api.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json`, `packages/spec/json-schema.manifest/api.json` (+`api/PackageExportBundle`), `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (+`api/PackageExportBundle:packages`), `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/api.md` (`api/` 484 → 485). All written by `check:generated --fix`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/28914-package-export-bundle.md`, `@objectstack/spec: minor`.

### Forced test edits

None. No existing test changed.

## Why

The maintainer's ruling on docs.objectos.ai #334 (record 6568804196): 「Cloud/Enterprise 租户怎么导出本体?同意,同时立开发卡。」 Today a tenant can export its ontology only one package at a time. This is the spec slice: it declares the read's answer first, and the server slice (the route in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `os package export` in `packages/cli`, the round-trip and credential tests) is `Blocked-by` this PR.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`, a new describe with 5 tests over a bundle shaped as the card's done criteria name it (a base, its `.custom` pair with an `overrides` block, and a third package extending the base; the base carries a connector whose `auth` keeps `credentialRef`):

- the bundle parses and every entry is preserved, in the order listed;
- the element of `packages` is `PackageExportManifestSchema` itself, and an entry with no identity is refused at `packages.1.id`, `packages.1.name` and `packages.1.version`;
- an empty bundle parses (a deployment that holds only platform packages);
- an answer with no `packages` is refused at `packages`;
- an unknown top-level member is refused `unrecognized_keys` naming it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Route, not a member of an existing read (the seat's lean, taken).** A member of `GET /packages` (`ListInstalledPackagesResponseSchema`) would make every list call pay for 27 metadata types per package, and the list keeps its own query set (`status`, `type`, `enabled`). The path cannot collide: `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` needs at least two dot-separated segments, so `export` is never a package id and never shadows `GET /packages/:id`.
- **Where the route is declared.** Measured on `origin/main` `135054eb`: neither `package-api.zod.ts` nor `package-api-assembled.zod.ts` carries `GET /packages/:id/export`. That route is declared by its response schema's docblock and the runtime route ledger row (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`, `responseSchema: 'PackageExportManifestSchema'`). `PackageApiContracts` says a route is declared there "only in the same change that MOUNTS it — never ahead of its door". So this PR adds no `PackageApiContracts` entry and no ledger row; the server slice adds the row (`responseSchema: 'PackageExportBundleSchema'`) with the mount.
- **No request schema.** The door reads no path id, no body and no query parameter, so there is nothing to declare beyond the closed empty set, which the docblock states. `GetPackageCustomizationsRequestSchema` exists because that door has a path id.
- **No liveness row.** `check:liveness` ledgers are per metadata type (`packages/spec/liveness/TYPE.json`); an API response schema has none. `check:liveness` is green.
- **The per-package export does not carry what a reinstall reads (for the server slice).** Read on this head: `assemblePackageManifest` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) sets only `id`, `name`, `version` and `label` beside the metadata collections. It drops `manifest.namespace` and `manifest.dependencies`. A body with no namespace gets `installPackage`'s id-derived default (`deriveNamespaceFromPackageId`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts`), and for a pair that is `custom`, not the base's `NS_custom`: the exact case `protocol-customization-package.ts` sets the namespace explicitly to avoid. So the round trip of a `.custom` pair likely fails until the per-package export carries both keys. This is a reading of source, not a reproduction; the server slice's round-trip test is the measurement. If it holds, `PackageExportManifestSchema` gains two declared fixed keys, which is a spec change (see Open questions).
- **The client SDK is untouched.** `client.packages.exportAll` (or similar) and the `unwrap-misfire.pin.test.ts` roster row belong with the server slice. `{ packages }` declares neither `success` nor `data`, so the unwrap heuristic cannot fire on it.

## Open questions (for the maintainer, through the seat)

1. **New public names.** The route path `GET /api/v1/packages/export`; the schema `PackageExportBundleSchema` and its types `PackageExportBundle` / `PackageExportBundleParsed`; the key `packages`. Recommendation: approve as written. They sit beside `PackageExportManifestSchema` and the existing `packages` key of `GET /packages`.
2. **Platform packages are not exported.** Options: A, every package but manifest `scope: 'system'` (this PR); B, every package `GET /packages` lists, with the consumer skipping what the target already has. Recommendation: A. The card's done criterion ("a base, its pair and a third package produce three installable packages") holds only if the platform packages every runtime registers are left out (30 source files under `packages/` declare `scope: 'system'`), and with B every install of the bundle would re-install platform packages the target already ships.
3. **The per-package export's missing `namespace` and `dependencies`.** Options: A, the server slice measures the round trip first and, if a pair fails, a spec card adds both as declared fixed keys of `PackageExportManifestSchema`; B, add them in this PR now. Recommendation: A. Declaring keys no producer emits yet would be declared-not-enforced, and the measurement belongs to the slice that runs the install.

## Verification

- `package-lifecycle.zod.ts`, `z.array(PackageExportManifestSchema)` → `z.array(` a hand-copied four-key object with an open catch-all `)`: 1 failed | 29 passed ("judges each entry by THE per-package export schema"). Every other test stayed green, so the copy is indistinguishable by parse alone and only the identity pin catches it. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- Reverse type probe in `packages/runtime/src` against the rebuilt `.d.ts`: `const ok: PackageExportBundle = { packages: [ … ] }` compiles; `{ packages: [], cycles: [] }` is TS2353 (`'cycles' does not exist in type …`), the probe's only error. Probe deleted; `git status` clean.

</details>

- All 103 exit 0 on `0493264f`. On the first pass `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `dist/` for connector-slack, organizations, service-print in this container). After building those three it reported 115 entry points across 70 packages load, exit 0.

- Local-only families: `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0. `check:dev-prereqs` exit 1 is a box precondition (35 `ui/` workspace dists not built in this container), not a reading about this diff.
